title: Marshall Yards, East Road, Dublin 3

prs.location:
Marshall Yards sits in Dublin’s historic Docklands, a central district buzzing with urban energy. It offers seamless access to the city, blending rich history with an exciting future, as well as access to the newly opened Dublin Port Tolka Estuary Greenway.

Marshall Yards provides easy access to:
•	Rail & Luas Stations
•	Bus Stops
•	Dublin City Bike Stations
•	Dublin Port
•	M50 Motorway
•	Dublin Airport

description:
Discover your new home at Marshall Yards, Dublin's newest prime residential location in the heart of the Dublin Docklands.


 *FREE High Speed Wifi Included*


Experience the ease and convenience of city-centre living at Marshall Yards, with stylish rental apartments, resident's gym, pickle ball court, co working spaces, resident's lounge, rooftop terraces, outdoor BBQ area and 24 hour concierge/ security.  
Then easily step outside to enjoy the vibrant cafes, shops and cultural spots of Dublin's historic Docklands.


Marshall Yards offers a range of apartment sizes and styles from Studio, 1 Bedroom, 2 Bedroom and 3 Bedrooms.  Each apartment features high-quality finishes, energy efficient appliances and spacious layouts.  Our curated selection of branded furniture showcases exceptional craftmanship, ensuring residents enjoy both comfort and style. 


Apartment features:

-	Complimentary Fast Fibre Broadband
-	Fully Furnished with Contemporary Designed Interiors
-	Premium Integrated Kitchen
-	Private Balcony
-	Premium Finishes
-	Smart Heating System
-	Clever storage solutions
-	City, Sea, or Mountain Views
-	Energy-Efficient
-	Pet-Friendly


At Marshall Yards, we're proud to be a top certified sustainable development which is proof of our deep commitment to the planet and your well-being.  Marshall Yards efficient design and smart building technologies helps to reduce your carbon footprint while lowering utility costs, so you can live sustainably without compromising on comfort or affordability.


Marshall Yards amenities go beyond convenience, offering a fully considered living experience that feels seamless and effortless. 

Resident Amenities:

-	FREE High Speed WiFi Throughout the Development
-	MY Gym - Fitted with Premium TechnoGym Equipment
-	Co Working Space with Bookable Meeting Rooms
-	Resident's Lounge
-	MY Cafe
-	Concierge
-	MYLiving Resident App
-	Tulu
-	Parcel Lockers
-	Car Club
-	Electric Scooters
-	Electric Car Charging Points
-	My Comfort+
-	Community Events
-	Bookable Private Kitchen
-	Outdoor BBQ Area
-	Pickleball Courts
-	Rooftop Terraces


From your home to the wider community, every detail crafted to enhance your lifestyle and ensure you feel completely at home, every day.

Visit www.marshallyards.com for more details and to schedule a guided tour or a virtual viewing.


Make Marshall Yards Your New Home Today!
